entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-05
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • OleDbDataReader.GetBytes/GetChars throw ArgumentOutOfRangeException for a zero-length read at the end of the buffer #137051
  • DbTransaction.SupportsSavepoints docs say Release/ReleaseAsync are expected to throw, but they are no-ops by design #137040
  • System.Data.OleDb: OleDbParameterCollection.RemoveAt throws IndexOutOfRangeException, IList.RemoveAt documents ArgumentOutOfRangeException #137039
  • Runtime async: await and .Result reach different overrides when a [PreserveBaseOverrides] MethodImpl names the grand-base method #137038
  • Consider generic code sharing for single-object-field C# union structs #137028
    Future
  • Support pre-shared keys authentication for TLS 1.3 #137021
    12.0.0

    Future

  • Finalization in multithreaded WASM #137000
    Future
  • Remove linux-x86 support in .NET 12 #136997

    12.0.0
  • SoundPlayer.Play() does not preserve in-memory WAV buffer lifetime #136991

Closed

  • [arm64][macOS] SDK dotnet test child crashes reading 0x4000 from an immediate call-target-cell address #136918
  • JsonSchemaExporter doesn't respect IgnoreReadOnlyProperties/IgnoreReadOnlyFields #131632
    12.0.0
  • [RuntimeAsync] Handle covariant returns scenarios in combination with task-returning methods. #124238
    12.0.0
  • R2R signature formatter labels Check_VirtualFunctionOverride fixups as Verify_VirtualFunctionOverride #136930
  • ControlledExecution.Run aborts a thread only once on Linux and macOS: a second abort on the same thread never lands (Windows aborts every time) #136873
  • Does CVE-2026-111497 affect System.IO.Compression.Brotli in .NET 9 and 10? #136422
  • [API Proposal]: Extend configuration binding for delimited values #136409
  • Tracking: Migrate Ubuntu 22.04/24.04 infrastructure on main to Azure Linux 4 or Ubuntu 26.04 #136313
  • SetILInstrumentedCodeMap frees the previous map while another thread may still be reading it (use-after-free) #136804
  • Http2Stream.SendDataAsync can throw NullReferenceException when the stream completes during a credit wait #136841
  • [API Proposal]: Make IsApplePlatform public #113262
    Future
  • TimeZoneInfo applies the previous year's standard offset for one hour at the 2026/2027 boundary of the new Canadian Windows time zones (Manitoba, Alberta, British Columbia); Windows API converts correctly #136894
    Future
